mapper.select: SELECT id FROM write_guard WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE student_no=#{account}
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE student_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash=#{hash} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET blocked_until=#{until} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat s WHERE s.room_id=r.id AND s.enabled=1) seat_count FROM reading_room r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT * FROM reading_room WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT s.*,r.name room_name FROM seat s JOIN reading_room r ON r.id=s.room_id WHERE room_id=#{roomId} ORDER BY row_no,col_no
SELECT s.*,r.name room_name FROM seat s JOIN reading_room r ON r.id=s.room_id WHERE s.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM room_opening WHERE room_id=#{roomId} AND special_date=#{date}
SELECT * FROM room_opening ORDER BY special_date DESC,id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_opening(room_id,special_date,is_closed,open_time,close_time,reason) VALUES(#{roomId},#{specialDate},#{isClosed},#{openTime},#{closeTime},#{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_closed=VALUES(is_closed),open_time=VALUES(open_time),close_time=VALUES(close_time),reason=VALUES(reason)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_rule WHERE effective_at <= #{now} ORDER BY effective_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM system_rule WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM system_rule ORDER BY effective_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.sql: SELECT a.*,s.seat_no,r.name room_name,u.student_no,u.name user_name FROM reservation a JOIN seat s ON s.id=a.seat_id JOIN reading_room r ON r.id=s.room_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE a.id=#{id}
WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.request_key=#{key}
WHERE a.status IN ('RESERVED','CHECKED_IN','TEMP_LEFT') ORDER BY a.id

where.if: AND (u.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR a.reservation_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%'))
AND a.start_time >= #{date} AND a.start_time < DATE_ADD(#{date},INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select: ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.user_id
SELECT * FROM reservation_event WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE usage_session SET end_time=GREATEST(start_time,#{end}),end_reason=#{reason} WHERE reservation_id=#{id} AND end_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT v.*,u.student_no,u.name user_name FROM violation_record v JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=v.user_id WHERE v.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM violation_record WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM violation_record WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM violation_record WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND is_revoked=0 ORDER BY occurred_at,id
mapper.update: UPDATE violation_record SET is_revoked=1,revoked_by=#{revokedBy},revoked_at=#{revokedAt},revoke_reason=#{revokeReason} WHERE id=#{id} AND is_revoked=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcement WHERE published=1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT a.*,u.name operator_name FROM audit_log a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.operator_id ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log

SELECT COUNT(*) reservations, COALESCE(SUM(a.status='CANCELLED'),0) cancelled, COALESCE(SUM(a.status='ADMIN_CLOSED'),0) adminClosed, COALESCE(SUM(a.checkin_at IS NOT NULL AND a.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','ADMIN_CLOSED') AND DATE_ADD(a.start_time,INTERVAL q.checkin_grace_minutes MINUTE) < #{now}),0) arrived, COALESCE(SUM(a.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','ADMIN_CLOSED') AND DATE_ADD(a.start_time,INTERVAL q.checkin_grace_minutes MINUTE) < #{now}),0) due, COALESCE(SUM(a.status='NO_SHOW'),0) noShow, COALESCE(SUM(a.status='LEAVE_TIMEOUT'),0) leaveTimeout FROM reservation a JOIN system_rule q ON q.id=a.rule_id WHERE a.start_time >= #{start} AND a.start_time < #{end}
